Item.Name: S_START_DATE
Item.Hint: Enter value for starting date IN MM-DD-YY format

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 dtLocalDate Date := get_local_date;
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 
 SELECT TO_DATE
 (
 TO_CHAR
 (
 decode
 (
 TO_CHAR(lDate, 'AM'),'AM',ROUND(lDate),TRUNC(lDate)
 )
 ,'MM-DD-YYYY'
 )
 ||' 23:59','MM-DD-YYYY HH24:MI'
 ) 
 INTO dtLocalDate
 FROM(
 SELECT dtLocalDate lDate
 FROM dual
 );
 
 --if :s_start_date > trunc(sysdate)
 if :s_start_date > get_local_date
 then
 show_error('0143');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if :s_end_date is not null then
 if trunc(:s_end_date) < trunc(:s_start_date)
 then
 show_error('0073');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 exception
 when VALUE_ERROR
 then
 null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* This trigger is used to get the Check Digit from the Validate_unit_chkdigit procedure
 corresponding to the Unit Id in the Code128 system */

DECLARE
 temp_v_chk_digit varchar2(10);
BEGIN
 IF length(:unit_id) = 13
 THEN
 validate_unit_chkdigit(:unit_id, temp_v_chk_digit);
 :temp_units.chk_digit := temp_v_chk_digit;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_LOCAL_DATE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION get_local_date(v_date IN DATE DEFAULT SYSDATE) RETURN DATE
/* Function to return local date value, in case no parameter this
will return system date converted to local date--*/
 IS
 v_localdate DATE;
BEGIN
 /* To display local time*/
 if is_timezone_enabled 
 then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,v_date ,v_localdate);
 else
 v_localdate := sysdate;
 end if;

 return v_localdate;
END;
